library(GEOquery)

library(umap)

code

# Version info: R 4.2.2, Biobase 2.58.0, GEOquery 2.66.0, limma 3.54.0
################################################################
#   Data plots for selected GEO samples

# load series and platform data from GEO

gset <- getGEO("GSE30529", GSEMatrix =TRUE, getGPL=FALSE)
G3;Found 1 file(s)
gG3;GSE30529_series_matrix.txt.gz
gG3;Using locally cached version: /var/folders/dq/m9jbf2_x2_v6cnd1c0nt1rc40000gn/T//Rtmpcr6mPY/GSE30529_series_matrix.txt.gz
g
if (length(gset) > 1) idx <- grep("GPL571", attr(gset, "names")) else idx <- 1
gset <- gset[[idx]]

ex <- exprs(gset)
write.csv(ex,file = './ex.csv')
# log2 transform
qx <- as.numeric(quantile(ex, c(0., 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99, 1.0), na.rm=T))
LogC <- (qx[5] > 100) ||
          (qx[6]-qx[1] > 50 && qx[2] > 0)
if (LogC) { ex[which(ex <= 0)] <- NaN
  ex <- log2(ex) }

# box-and-whisker plot
par(mar=c(7,4,2,1))
title <- paste ("GSE30529", "/", annotation(gset), sep ="")
boxplot(ex, boxwex=0.7, notch=T, main=title, outline=FALSE, las=2)

# expression value distribution plot
par(mar=c(4,4,2,1))

title <- paste ("GSE30529", "/", annotation(gset), " value distribution", sep ="")
plotDensities(ex, main=title, legend=F)


# mean-variance trend
ex <- na.omit(ex) # eliminate rows with NAs
plotSA(lmFit(ex), main="Mean variance trend, GSE30529")


# UMAP plot (multi-dimensional scaling)
ex <- ex[!duplicated(ex), ]  # remove duplicates
ump <- umap(t(ex), n_neighbors = 9, random_state = 123)
plot(ump$layout, main="UMAP plot, nbrs=9", xlab="", ylab="", pch=20, cex=1.5)
